caseName: Panhandle Eastern Pipe Line Co. v. Federal Power Commission
caseNameFull: Panhandle Eastern Pipe Line Co. v. Federal Power Commission
attorneys: Messrs. Ira Lloyd Letts, John S. L. Yost, D. H. Culton, and Samuel H. Biggs for petitioners.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to file petition for rehearing, is granted. The petition for rehearing is granted and the order entered November 13, ante, p. 700, is vacated. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit granted limited to questions 2 and 3 presented by the petition for the writ.
